name: BTC active addresses healthy + price oversold — bullish on-chain/price divergence (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why the divergence leads a bounce): when PRICE sells off (RSI oversold) but on-chain usage (active addresses) stays HEALTHY, the drop is driven by leverage/sentiment, not a collapse in real demand — a classic bullish divergence between fundamentals and price. On-chain activity, being sticky and demand-driven, holds up through speculative flushes and 'anchors' the recovery, so the healthy-activity read leads the mean-reversion. Distinct from the momentum spec on the same feature: there activity CONFIRMS an uptrend; here it DIVERGES from a downtrend. Exit on RSI reverting up. DISCONFIRMER 1: if RSI-oversold alone matches the deflated Sharpe, the on-chain arm adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2: if activity also rolls over with price (no divergence, just a broad risk-off) the setup should NOT fire — if the fit relaxes the address floor to always-true, there is no divergence being captured. Data knowable T+1. tier1, low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: btc_active_addresses stays elevated (fundamentals intact) while RSI is oversold — price weak, network strong.
